- Confirm legal entity name exactly as you file invoices.
- Confirm tax ID (we have the W-9 but please verify the number on page 1).
- New ACH account number and routing (we’ll store masked version in the ledger).
- Bank beneficiary name and business address (for wire verification).
- Expected start date for new routing (first payment you’d like routed to new account).
